scope: Current Xenoverse 2 acquisition/mechanics reconciliation for Psycho Escape, Justice Pose, and Kaioken

records.name: Psycho Escape
evidence: Current Xenoverse 2 skill documentation identifies Psycho Escape as an Other Evasive used by Guldo and obtained from PQ13.
The maintained all-186-PQ guide lists Psycho Escape under PQ13 Basic Rewards.
A launch-era Steam discussion independently confirms players obtain Psycho Escape from PQ13 and documents the reward-drop uncertainty without establishing a numeric rate.
Current dedicated skill documentation describes telekinetic immobilization followed by forced lock-off and escape; the move deals no damage and consumes 200 Stamina.
limits: No numerical drop probability is promoted.
Older cross-game acquisition references are not treated as Xenoverse 2 evidence.
Exact frame timing and version-sensitive behavior remain unresolved.

records.name: Justice Pose
records.acquisition: Parallel Quest 53 — The Fist of Justice
evidence: Current Xenoverse 2 skill documentation identifies Justice Pose as a Power Up Super obtained from PQ53 and used by Great Saiyaman/Great Saiyaman 2.
The maintained all-186-PQ guide lists Justice Pose under PQ53 Basic Rewards.
Independent Dragon Ball reference material identifies PQ53 as the Xenoverse 2 Future Warrior acquisition route.
Current skill documentation states that the pose boosts all abilities for 20 seconds; the repository already records the 0-Ki Power Up semantics.

promoted_fields.source_quest_or_shop: Parallel Quest 53 — The Fist of Justice

limits: No numerical drop probability is promoted.
Version-sensitive exact modifier values remain bounded to existing repository evidence.

records.name: Kaioken
evidence: Current Xenoverse 2 skill documentation identifies Kaioken as a universal CaC Awoken Skill obtained from PQ8 with an Ultimate Finish.
Current documentation records the 100/300/500 Ki thresholds for Kaioken, x3 Kaioken, and x20 Kaioken and the corresponding stamina-drain behavior.

A launch-era Steam discussion states that the PQ8 Ultimate Finish occurs by preserving Nappa through the Goku sequence, defeating the resulting x3 Kaioken Goku, and that the skill reward is RNG-dependent.

Current GameFAQs answers independently associate Kaioken with the PQ8 Ultimate Finish and report the reward as a non-guaranteed drop; these reports are retained as historical corroboration rather than as a numeric probability.
limits: No numerical drop probability is promoted.
Historical player reports about exact reward timing are not treated as deterministic mechanics beyond the established Ultimate Finish boundary.
Version-sensitive balance values remain bounded to current documented mechanics.

evidence_boundary: This batch strengthens current Xenoverse 2 acquisition and mechanics provenance for three already-indexed skills. It preserves existing canonical relationships and does not infer numerical drop rates or unsupported reward conditions.
